merged_guidance.title: Keep persistent work ownership separate from a view subscription
merged_guidance.applicability: The current implementation documents a persistent document buffer, store or coordinator that outlives a view owning only its current live/status subscription.
merged_guidance.event_relation: Keep accepted pending work bound to its original document owner. On departure, release the subscription captured by that view without discarding or redirecting persistent work or destroying a task that must remain reusable. Reopening locates the buffer by document identity.
merged_guidance.preservation: Preserve original identity/text/payload semantics, independent document buffers, same-document reopening, continuing persistence responsibility, document presentation and current-view status filtering. Determine the actual owner from the current source.
merged_guidance.exclusion: View detachment does not imply cancellation. Persistent ownership alone does not establish a before-return departure flush; derive settlement scheduling from the current contract. Do not transfer durable retention to a transient preview with a discard-on-hide policy.
merged_guidance.verification: Switch, close, dispose and reopen with pending work. Check eventual persistence to the original owner, buffer reuse, subscription release, independent documents and current-view output separately; check immediate settlement only when the source requires that deadline.

record.title: Keep persistent ownership independent of view subscriptions
record.applicability: A documented document buffer or other persistent owner outlives a view that owns only its live subscription.
record.event_relation: Keep accepted persistent work associated with its original owner when the view detaches. Clean up the captured subscription without discarding or redirecting that work or destroying required reuse.
record.preservation: Keep current-view status filtering, document presentation and original identity/text/payload semantics. Reconcile departure scheduling using the current contract.
record.exclusion: Persistent ownership alone does not establish a before-return persistence deadline. Do not transfer durable-work retention to transient preview work.
record.verification: Switch, close, dispose and reopen while work is pending; check original-owner persistence, subscription cleanup, independent buffers and current-view output.

record.title: Clean up document buffers and view subscriptions separately
record.applicability: A store, BufferBank or coordinator dictionary owns persistent document buffers; the view owns only its current status subscription.
record.event_relation: On departure, clean up the subscription captured by that view without discarding pending document text or destroying a document task that must remain reusable. Reopening locates its buffer by document identity.
record.preservation: Preserve isolation between documents, same-document reopening, status unsubscription and continuing persistence responsibility. Determine the actual owner from the current implementation.
record.exclusion: View detachment does not imply cancellation of persistent work. Persistent ownership alone also does not require immediate departure flushing.
record.verification: Switch, close, dispose and reopen the same document with pending text. Check buffer reuse, subscription release and eventual persistence to the original document separately.

obligation_checklist: Preserve origin identity, subscription cleanup and reopening.
Persistent ownership does not establish synchronous departure flush.
Do not transfer retention to transient preview discard.
scope: User-authorized source-preserving consolidation; source quotations are historical evidence, not requirements for a new task. No new model evaluation or effectiveness claim.
